rulesTestNames: lets a guest get an event's guest entry and only their own status
read: a signed-in, non-deleted guest gets the row whose id ends in their uid ({eventId}_{uid}; a missing row reads as missing), never by the stored uid field, and lists only rows whose uid is theirs
write: server only; triggers on eventBookings, eventAttendees, guestPayments, organizerApplications, organizerEventOfferRecipients and events rebuild a row from the guest's own records and delete it when none remain
migrationNotes: Replaced the getEventViewerState guest surface for the website event page (#1337); that callable is retired. Backfilled by the guest-event-read-models migration; account deletion removes it.
Carries participationStatus and the guest event card for the guest's booking lists (#1340); the guest-event-cards migration fills them on older rows.

Carries rosterLink, the guest's own linked roster row, for the Catch app's event message preferences instead of getEventAssistanceParticipantContext (#2306 batch E); the guest-roster-links migration fills it on older rows and creates rows for linked guests without one.
